answer: Treat each new agent as a vertex that must post a 50 POA bond before it can attest. If graders later find two vertices whose stake traces to one funding wallet, both bonds are slashed. A summit of a thousand fake agents then costs 50,000 POA up front and loses it all on detection, while one honest agent risks only its own bond. Signing keys alone are a cheap cipher anyone can mint; locked capital is not.
